basis: SHA-256 of Git blob bytes at the named provider revision; not measured campaign runtime bytes

mismatch_characterization.measured: Each transcribed digest differs from the Git blob digest by one transcription slip: one deleted character (renderer, 63 recorded characters), one transposed pair (state, offsets 58 and 60), and one substituted character (session, offset 14).
mismatch_characterization.implication: These edit patterns describe the erroneous public transcription only. Digest similarity alone does not establish which source bytes ran; reconciliation uses the separately retained original campaign records.
mismatch_characterization.transcription_preservation: The earlier public transcription is preserved byte-for-byte in transcribed_record_file; record_file restores the source digests reported by the retained original campaign artifacts.

reconciliation: All five source digests in the retained original campaign report and pre-publication export match the named Git blobs. Every public receipt field matches the retained independent peer snapshot. The corrected record restores those original digests; the earlier public transcription is retained separately.
verification_limits: This reconciles retained campaign records, not a fresh measurement of historical runtime bytes or an authentication of the observations. No repeat campaign was run.
